scope: Footer information dialog, immediate menu navigation, centered VOKU On heading, and community search toggle
browserEnvironment: Desktop in-app browser at mobile viewport sizes; not a physical device benchmark
actualAppChecks: Footer dialog opens without backdrop fade or container transform, preserving scroll and focus on close
Menu heading retains 12px type and vertical center at 32px; horizontal center is 160px in the 320px viewport
Menu navigation and browser back remove the menu and temporary page layer together
Opening information from the menu leaves only the information dialog, without a closing menu underneath
Search button toggles open and closed, moves focus to the input, and preserves an unsubmitted search draft
Closing search after submitting preserves the URL query and results; reopening restores the search term
Keyboard Enter toggles search; search cancellation still works while the form is closed
